oral_examination.oral_examination: *38 has not erupted, and there is no redness or swelling in the surrounding gums. CBCT showed that it was horizontally impacted, the apex of the root was curved, and it was close to the mandibular neural canal.

source_handle: Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. 2% lidocaine block anesthesia, 4% articaine local infiltration anesthesia, make a horizontal incision, divide the crown, divide the gingiva, increase the gap, loosen, push out, suture two stitches, and compress to stop bleeding.
